text:
maria: Quick async sync for the v2 rollout — want to confirm ownership + blockers before we lock the canary on Monday. TL;DR: SDK bump, routing fallback, webhook deprecation note, and infra quota for dedicated tenants. cc @alex @sandeep

alex: I can take the routing fallback policy. Plan is to add a transparent model-variant mapping in the router and an opt-in header. Need SDK to expose header support.

sandeep: Got it. I'll own the header flag in the SDK. ETA: PR by EOD Thu. I'll also add a small migration note in the changelog.

maria: Thanks. Can everyone confirm if the SDK change is strictly additive (no breaking API)? we need canary without forcing client updates.

sandeep: Additive. New header: `x-redwood-model-fallback: variant=v2-lite` — defaults to off. No signature or body changes.

julie: Product reminder — we need a short deprecation line on the console + docs for webhooks. Also need a migration playbook for customers on Dedicated. Can we get that by next Wed?

maria: Yes, Julie — SRE + CS will need the playbook draft. @chris are you able to confirm infra quotas for the first wave of dedicated tenants (5 orgs)?

chris: Checking quotas now. Primary constraint is ephemeral GPU headroom during canary bursts. I can allocate a 20% buffer for the canary group, but we need an autoscale policy tweak (min replicas + burst) — I'll put the exact config in the ticket.

alex: For the router change, small snippet of the policy we'll add (for ops reference):
```
routePolicy: 
  - match: request.header["x-redwood-model-fallback"] == "variant=v2-lite"
    action: route_to: model_v2_lite_pool
  - fallback: route_to: model_v2_standard_pool
```

maria: Nice. Two action items for owners: 1) @sandeep SDK PR by Thu, include tests + changelog note. 2) @alex router PR and canary config by Fri. 3) @chris confirm autoscale JSON in ticket by EOD Fri. 4) @julie migration playbook draft by Wed next week.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-router-config v0.3 -> staging at 2026-03-20T02:00Z (automated smoke tests).

alex: One more question — how strict is the rollback policy? If we see quality regressions, do we fallback to v1 automatically or only after manual signoff?

maria: We want automatic graceful fallback to v1 for 5xx or high-latency signals, but not for quality regressions. Quality regressions trigger an alert to incident channel and a manual rollback decision. I can write the SLO triggers.

julie: Also flagging legal/cust-data teams: any customers in Dedicated with private variants need a heads-up. I'll draft a short customer email once we have dates.

sandeep: SDK PR will include an integration test that asserts header is sent -> router picks v2-lite. I'll also add a note in the README with migration steps.

chris: Posted autoscale draft in ticket #INF-412. Includes min_replicas=3, burst_pool=2, target_cpu=70%. If we need more buffer we can bump burst_pool to 4.

maria: Perfect. If owners can drop a one-line status update here when each task is done we can close the coordination loop. I'll collate for the Monday rollout readout. :thumbsup:

alex: Router PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/routers/pulls/88 (WIP). Adding canary config now.

sandeep: SDK PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/sdk/pulls/412 — tests passing locally.

maria: Great progress — thanks team. If any blockers pop up ping me directly.

chris: Quota confirmed for first wave. Will watch usage during canary.

julie: Playbook skeleton uploaded to google drive: https://drive.redwood/drive/folders/1abc — will flesh out details tomorrow.

maria: Closing this thread — last check: any remaining concerns?

alex: none from runtime side.

sandeep: none. merging later today.

maria: OK closing — will move status to the release board.
